title: US top commander warns troops their videos help Iran — Reuters
text:
US top commander warns troops their videos help Iran — Reuters"

"Admiral Brad Cooper says cellphone footage can tip off Iran to American base locations"

"Some deployed troops may soon be ordered to hand over their phones"

"Footage recorded by a US soldier using Meta glasses shows troops evacuating into bunkers during an Iranian missile attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan
